chunks.text: Lantern relay needs fewer handoffs per round than bucket chaining when convoy length m is smaller than depot count k.
Fewer relay hops between depots make distant deliveries easier to coordinate.
Lantern relay needs a fixed number of sequential rounds; bucket chaining needs m sequential rounds. Round count is distinct from total handoff cost.
